name: Endless.Fishing
summary: Endless.Fishing is a 3D fishing game for Windows set on German waters. Find your fishing spot, choose rod, line, hook and bait to match your plan, cast out, watch the float, set the hook at the right moment and play the fish safely to the shore. The current early test version focuses on float fishing with a pole and spin fishing at an alpine lake, with species such as perch, brown trout, chub and pike. Further fishing methods, waters, countries and content are being developed and released step by step. An internet connection and a player account are required.
